identify: The rice leaf is folded and a small caterpillar lives inside the fold.
The leaf folder is a major rice pest in India.

thresholds.etl: Early to late tillering: 2 Fully damaged leaves (FDL) with larva/hill.

cultural: Plant early to avoid heavy leaf damage.
Use wider spacing and a low dose of nitrogen fertilizer.
biological: Release Trichogramma japonicum or T. chilonis at 1 lakh/ha when you see egg masses or moths.
Protect spiders and other natural enemies in the field.

cultural: Plant early to avoid heavy leaf damage.
Use wider spacing and a low dose of nitrogen fertilizer.
Do not over-fertilize the field. Highly fertilized plots attract the moths.
Remove the causes of shade in the field. Damage is higher in shaded areas.

safety: Spray only when the pest count crosses the threshold. Wear gloves and a mask when you spray.

stage_notes.vegetative: Act when you count 2 fully damaged leaves with larva per hill.
